footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted under the Issuer's 2026 Equity Incentive Plan to the Reporting Person in connection with an amendment to his employment agreement with the Issuer. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock of the Issuer. || Represents the first of three equal tranches of 190,000 RSUs comprising a total grant of 570,000 RSUs. This first tranche is not subject to any key performance indicators and vests over a period of 36 months in 36 equal monthly installments commencing on September 3, 2026, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued service with the Issuer through the applicable vesting date.
